# Third-party code in this repository

Every piece keeps its license; the license file sits next to the code. All are compatible with the port's
GPL-3.0-or-later.

| Folder | What | From | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `maxwell_shader/` | The Ryujinx 1.3.2 shader translator, unchanged apart from the patches below (Ryujinx Team and contributors) (`Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader`, `Ryujinx.Common`, `Spv.Generator`) | MacNativeGames `vendor/ryujinx` @b75be8c (Ryujinx 1.3.2, unmodified there), with the patches of `shader_translator/patches/` applied here (0001-0004 MacNativeGames', 0005-0006 ours) | MIT (`maxwell_shader/LICENSE.txt`) |
| `fsr1/` | AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1: `ffx/ffx_a.h`, `ffx/ffx_fsr1.h` (AMD, unchanged) and totk-pc-recomp's compute shaders around them (`fsr_easu.comp`, `fsr_rcas.comp`) with their SPIR-V (`*_spv.h`, generated by its `tools/build_shaders.py`); the present's upscale (`src/vk/fsr.c`) | totk-pc-recomp `runtime/shaders`, `runtime/*_spv.h` @c3b9a4e | MIT (`fsr1/ffx/LICENSE.txt`, `fsr1/LICENSE-totk-pc-recomp.txt`) |
| `fsr3/` | AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3.1 upscaler: its GLSL passes and the GPU headers they include (`gpu/`, `passes/`, unchanged) and their SPIR-V with the bindings read back (`fsr3_spv.h`, generated by `tools/build_fsr3.py`); the game's temporal upscaler (`src/gfx/vkb_tsr.c`) | FidelityFX SDK `sdk/include/FidelityFX/gpu`, `sdk/src/backends/vk/shaders/fsr3upscaler` @v1.1.4 (c6efa6b) | MIT (`fsr3/LICENSE.txt`) |
| `smaa/` | SMAA (Jorge Jimenez, Jose I. Echevarria, Belen Masia, Fernando Navarro, Diego Gutierrez): `SMAA.hlsl`, `AreaTex.h`, `SearchTex.h` (unchanged); the port's compute passes around it (`src/gfx/shaders/smaa.comp`, compiled into `src/gfx/vkb_smaa_spv.h` by `tools/build_smaa.py`); SMAA 1x in place of the game's FXAA (`src/gfx/vkb_smaa.c`, antialias=smaa) | iryoku/smaa @71c806a | MIT (`smaa/LICENSE.txt`) |
| `stb/` | `stb_truetype.h` 1.26 (Sean Barrett): the glyphs of the software keyboard's text field (`src/host/text_entry.c`), unchanged | nothings/stb @6e9f34d | MIT or public domain (`stb/LICENSE`) |
| `shader_translator/` | MacNativeGames' `totk_xlate`: the service around that translator that turns the game's NVN shaders into SPIR-V; built as `ultrs-shaders.exe` by `tools/build_xlate.py` | MacNativeGames `games/totk/tools/totk_xlate` @b75be8c, without its macOS build script | MIT (`shader_translator/LICENSE`) |

Elsewhere in the tree: `src/gfx/tex/bc7enc/` (bc7enc and rgbcx, Rich Geldreich, MIT) and the files ported from
MacNativeGames (MIT), LASRecomp (MIT), B2recomp (GPL-3.0) and totk-pc-recomp (MIT, its license text
`fsr1/LICENSE-totk-pc-recomp.txt`; the mouse camera `src/host/mouse_direct.c` and its sites in `tools/lifter/patches.py`),
each named in its header comment;
`tools/shaders/inventory.py` (MacNativeGames, MIT). The launcher's fonts in `assets/launcher/fonts/` (compiled into
the launcher by `tools/build_launcher.py`): Inter (The Inter Project Authors) and Montserrat Alternates (The Montserrat
Project Authors), both SIL Open Font License 1.1, their license texts next to them (`OFL-*.txt`). The game's own copy
of Inter in `assets/fonts/` (Inter-Regular, the launcher's `Inter_18pt-Regular.ttf`; `OFL-Inter.txt` next to it) is
compiled into the game for the software keyboard's text field (`src/host/text_entry.c`).

Downloaded when the launcher is built (`tools/build_launcher.py`: into `deps/launcher/`, not in git; each file pinned to
its upstream commit with its size and SHA-256 in `tools/deps.json`, "launcher"), unchanged: Dear ImGui 1.91.9b (Omar
Cornut and contributors; the core and the SDL3 / SDL_Renderer3 backends; MIT), NanoSVG (Mikko Mononen; zlib) and
`stb_image.h` 2.30 (Sean Barrett; MIT or public domain). Their licenses go into the builder package's `licenses/`.
